0859b518bac4.name: Explosive Demise
0859b518bac4.plain: When this model drops to 0 wounds, roll a dice before you remove it: on a 5+, every unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

0a0dfefa3d35.name: Servants of the Abyss
0a0dfefa3d35.plain: Units with this ability are set up along with OBSIDIUS MALLEX; if he isn't in your army, this ability does nothing. You can't set up any unit with this ability until OBSIDIUS MALLEX has been set up. When you set up OBSIDIUS MALLEX during deployment, every unit with this ability is set up straight away, at the same time. The first time OBSIDIUS MALLEX is set up on the battlefield, all units with this ability have to be placed within 6" of him (or in the same TRANSPORT he is in). If they can't be set up like this, they count as destroyed.

199ecba2a65e.name: Vox-caster
199ecba2a65e.plain: While a friendly TRAITOR ENFORCER unit is within 24" of the bearer's unit, the bearer's unit is treated as in range of the Forward, For the Dark Gods! ability of that TRAITOR ENFORCER unit.

1c42daacb6bf.name: Mallex's Followers
1c42daacb6bf.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, this unit can only be included in a Detachment that also contains OBSIDIUS MALLEX, and it doesn't use up a slot in a Detachment that contains OBSIDIUS MALLEX.

2c4b96877047.name: Savage Charge
2c4b96877047.plain: If this unit made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of its models.

2dcc4f865e04.name: Grenade launcher
2dcc4f865e04.plain: Each time you attack with this weapon, pick one of the profiles below.

3851f6f76f90.name: Malicious Volleys
3851f6f76f90.plain:
Models in this unit don't use the normal Rapid Fire rules for their Rapid Fire bolt weapons. Instead, a model shooting one of these weapons makes double the number of attacks if at least one of these is true:
• Its target is within half the weapon's range.
• It is an INFANTRY model whose unit Remained Stationary during your previous Movement phase.
• It is a TERMINATOR model or a BIKER model.
Here, 'Rapid Fire bolt weapon' means any bolt weapon whose type is Rapid Fire.

39a04b6274cb.name: Thunder hammer
39a04b6274cb.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, subtract 1 from that attack's hit roll.

412a8bbc2663.name: Enforcer
412a8bbc2663.plain: Friendly TRAITOR GUARDSMEN units that are within 6" of this model may use its Leadership instead of theirs.

4317b1652c00.name: Death to the False Emperor
4317b1652c00.plain: In the Fight phase, if a model in this unit is targeting an IMPERIUM unit, each time you roll a 6+ to hit for it, that model can at once make one extra attack against that same unit using the same weapon. These extra attacks can't trigger further extra attacks.

76f815b4fa99.name: Avalanche of Muscle
76f815b4fa99.plain: In any turn in which this model made a successful charge, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

83b62760995e.name: Unrestrained Power
83b62760995e.plain: On this model's Psychic tests, you can re-roll any dice that roll a 1, but it suffers Perils of the Warp on any double, not only a double 1 or double 6.

843ed55da334.name: Fanatical Devotion
843ed55da334.plain: Whenever a model in this unit would lose a wound, roll a D6. On a 5+, that wound isn't lost.

8561b6ad2020.name: Lord of Chaos
8561b6ad2020.plain: While within 6" of Obsidius Mallex, friendly BLACK LEGION units and friendly SERVANTS OF THE ABYSS units re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

8709b43b1882.name: Blasphemous Icon
8709b43b1882.plain: In the Movement phase, before this model moves, roll a D6. If you roll a 6, it regains 1 lost wound, and for the rest of that phase you can add 2" to its Move characteristic.

9d1b24591f3a.name: Electro-goads
9d1b24591f3a.plain: Each time you roll a 6 to hit with this weapon, that roll scores 3 hits.

9db3080e69a0.name: Bodyguard
9db3080e69a0.plain: Whenever a TRAITOR COMMISSAR loses a wound while any friendly models with this ability are within 3" of it, roll a D6. On a 3+, that wound is not lost by the TRAITOR COMMISSAR; instead, one of those friendly models suffers a mortal wound.

a48e27a6ad2a.name: Voltagheist Field
a48e27a6ad2a.plain: This unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save. Once this unit has completed a charge move, pick one of the units it charged, then roll a D6 for every model in this unit. Each 6 inflicts a mortal wound on the unit you picked.

ad3165b4b6a2.name: Mutant claw
ad3165b4b6a2.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it can make one attack with this weapon (and only one) before it makes any other attacks. If that attack hits, until the end of the phase you can re-roll hit rolls for the bearer's attacks against that unit.

af9b7f3bd7b0.name: Slaves to Mallex
af9b7f3bd7b0.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, this unit doesn't use up a slot in a Detachment that contains OBSIDIUS MALLEX.

e0e3f946b216.name: Sigil of Corruption
e0e3f946b216.plain: Obsidius Mallex gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

ec0ae54b243f.name: Forwards! For the Dark Gods!
ec0ae54b243f.plain: At the start of your Movement phase, you may pick a friendly TRAITOR GUARDSMEN unit that is within 6" of this model. That unit suffers 1 mortal wound. For the rest of the turn, add 3 to its Advance and Charge rolls.
